title: Object design
summary: Model a small system as classes, walk its main flows method by method, then extend it cleanly.

phases.title: Requirements
phases.goal: Open in about thirty words: first name, round and length, the problem's name, then ask who the main users are[[tool: , and call show_question]]. Let them scope: actors, main use cases, what is out of scope. Keep it in one process, not distributed design.

phases.title: Classes
phases.goal: They name the core classes with one responsibility each. Probe overloaded classes and nouns from their use cases that have no home.

phases.title: Relationships
phases.goal: They connect classes. Check each arrow kind against what they said: inheritance only for true is-a, composition where behaviour varies.

phases.title: Flows
phases.goal: Ask them to walk two main use cases method by method in pseudo code. Probe one state change or one concurrent case.

phases.title: Extension
phases.goal: Give the extension request. Ask what changes. If time allows, take one question. Close[[tool:  and call end_round]].
